reason: My spreadsheet, whiteboard and Xero do the job for a handful of buses, and I don't have the evenings to learn a whole new system and move everything across. Two hundred bucks a month is real money for me, nearly two and a half grand a year, for something I've managed without.
objection: It's a brand-new company with no customers. If it falls over or the business folds, my bookings are stuck in it, and I've wasted weeks setting it up instead of running trips.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial where they set it up for me, load my existing bookings, and it flags clashes so I never double-book a regular client again, plus an operator like me who's actually using it.
